name: @w6w-apps/webscrapingai
description: Scrape pages with JS rendering and proxies, extract by CSS selector, ask an LLM about a page, search Google and read structured site data through WebScraping.AI.

w6w.longDescription:
WebScraping.AI is a scraping API with headless-Chromium JavaScript rendering, rotating datacenter, residential and stealth proxies, and built-in HTML parsing. This app exposes its REST API to a workflow, authenticated with an API key.

A workflow can fetch a page's HTML or its visible text as Markdown, pull the HTML of one or many CSS selectors in a single fetch, and run its own JavaScript on a page. Two LLM endpoints answer a free-form question about a page or extract a set of named fields from it. It can also run a Google search and get parsed results, read structured JSON for a page on a supported site (YouTube, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit and more), and read the account's remaining credits.

Every call spends credits from the account; proxy tier and JavaScript rendering change the price, and failed requests are not billed.
